title: Pal-Awda plans Brooklyn protest against Israeli real estate event
seoTitle: NYC Pal-Awda protest Israeli real estate

tea.why: Protesters oppose religious institutions facilitating the sale of properties in Israel.
tea.want: To stop Israeli real estate sales events in New York City.
tea.changed: Nov 23: Pal-Awda announced a demonstration in Brooklyn for Wednesday following the dismantling of an NYPD police unit.

summary: The Palestine Right to Return Coalition (Pal-Awda) of New York and New Jersey, along with other groups such as Students for Justice in Palestine at CUNY City College, has announced a protest in Brooklyn targeting an upcoming Israeli real estate sales event promoted by CapitIL. According to reports, the demonstration is scheduled for Wednesday at 7 p.m. at an undisclosed location. Organizers stated it is unconscionable for institutions to facilitate property sales. Critics, including United Jewish Teachers president Moshe Spern, expressed concern over the safety of Jewish communities following the recent disbandment of the New York City Police Department's Strategic Response Group.
organizers: Students for Justice in Palestine at CUNY City College
demands: Halt the sale of properties in Israel at local religious institutions
response: No official response reported in the sources.

arrests.text: at least six arrests at Pal-Awda-affiliated demonstrations targeting Israeli real estate events in 2025 and 2026

updates.text: Pal-Awda announced a demonstration in Brooklyn following the dismantling of the NYPD Strategic Response Group.
